Think: early growth hires at prosumer AI tools, GTM engineers, ex-founders of SMB-facing AI startups. NOT big-co growth people.
constraints: Bay Area preferred, remote if exceptional

response_options.note: names/context only if owner escalates; contact info never (schema has no field)
